text:
maya.j: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's authz incident — I'm collecting owners and deadlines so we can close the remediation loop. Root causes were: token validation bypass in the auth proxy, perms drift on the analytics role, missing audit events for service-to-service calls, and a handful of rotated secrets not propagated to staging. Action items below (short):

maya.j: 1) Token validation tests & hotfix into staging — owner @raj.k — target: 48h. 2) Permissions audit sweep + remediation plan — owner @alex — target: next Tue. 3) Audit logging backfill + alert on missing events — owner @emma — target: end of week. 4) Secrets rotation reconciler (propagation job) — owner ops-oncall — target: 72h.

raj.k: I can take the token validation piece. Will add unit + integration tests. Plan: patch proxy, then smoke test against token-introspect.

maya.j: Thanks. Please add the test matrix to the follow-up doc and link it here.

raj.k: Will do. Quick note: failing case was when `exp` parsing dropped to float -> `==` comparisons broke. Fix will use constant-time time compare and explicit parsing. Example check: 
```
if (abs(int(exp) - now) < 2) { /* ok */ }
```

alex: I'll own the perms sweep. I'll run the ad-hoc policy diff tool across prod and staging, then submit a PR with role owner suggestions. ETA: Tue afternoon.

emma: For audit logging, I want to add a detector that flags services with >24h gaps in S2S event logs. Also propose an alert: "audit-gap:service_name". If accepted, I can wire it to the infra-alerting channel.

ops-oncall: I'll scope the secrets reconciler. We should avoid a mass restart — plan is a rolling reconciler that POSTs updated creds to endpoints. Will coordinate with SE to list critical services first.

maya.j: Good. Two cross-cutting items: 1) Add owners into the remediation tracker spreadsheet (link in the doc). 2) Set recurring postmortem pattern check — we saw tokens + perms recurring for 3 incidents in last 6 months. We need a permanent guardrail.

emma: Agree on the recurring check. I'll add a weekly report that surfaces token validation failures, policy diffs, and missing audit events. Will include a small dataset export so PMs can see trends.

alex: One more ask — can security-bot post a reminder for owners 24h before due date? helps with SLAs.

security-bot: Reminder scheduled: owners will be pinged at T-24h for items tracked under #incidents-remediation. Use `/remind` to change. :robot_face:

ops-oncall: Also adding a playbook update: add a step to rotate secrets -> verify propagation -> run smoke tests. I'll PR by EOD.

maya.j: OK, owners: @raj.k (token tests), @alex (perms sweep), @emma (audit gaps), @ops-oncall (secrets reconciler). Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept and paste a short confirmation line with the due date. I'll consolidate into the tracker and send weekly check-ins until all closed.

raj.k: :thumbsup: I accept — due 1953300000 (48h).

alex: :thumbsup: I accept — due 1953690000 (Tue EOD).

emma: :thumbsup: I accept — due 1953180000 (Fri EOD).

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: I accept — due 1953390000 (72h).

maya.j: Thanks all. Next sync: in 72h or earlier if any blocker. Posting follow-up doc link in #sec-ops.

security-bot: Follow-up doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/incidents/1953123456-aftercare — reminders and checklist attached.

emma: small follow-up Q — do we want a short retro note for eng leads on recurring perms drift? could help with process change.

maya.j: Yes — please draft a 1-paragraph retro and I'll share with eng leads after tracker shows remediation complete.

raj.k: Noted. I'll also include the failing token sample in the doc for future reference.

maya.j: Closing thread here — will reopen if any of the owners report blockers. Thanks everyone.
